mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stat.dim_district (code, name_en, name_ar, sort_no, municipality, makani_district_id, makani_name, centroid, bbox, boundary, scope, updated_at) VALUES (#{d.code}, #{d.nameEn}, #{d.nameAr}, #{d.sortNo}, #{d.municipality}, #{d.makaniDistrictId}, #{d.makaniName}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{d.centroidLon}, #{d.centroidLat}), 4326), ST_MakeEnvelope(#{d.minLon}, #{d.minLat}, #{d.maxLon}, #{d.maxLat}, 4326), ST_Multi(ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(#{d.boundaryEwkbHex}, 'hex'))), ST_Multi(ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(#{d.scopeEwkbHex}, 'hex'))), now())
